Whenever you need us. 365 days a year. ZAVA, inspired by the French words 'Ça va' (meaning 'how are you?') was founded by David Meinertz and Amit Khutti in 2010 before officially launching online under the name ‘DrEd’ in November 2011. As pioneers in digital healthcare, we have carried out more than 15 million consultations across Europe and over 7 million consultations in the UK alone. Thousands of patients visit ZAVA via the web every day. Every consultation is carried out by one of our experienced doctors in a safe, regulated way. We pride ourselves on delivering the highest levels of patient care for every patient who visits the site and have received well over 20,000 reviews across Europe (UK, France, Spain, & Germany) with thousands of positive experiences. At ZAVA we are proud to be a fully registered UK pharmacy, and are also one of the very few companies that have passed the recent round of CQC inspections for digital healthcare providers across all categories of care. The latest CQC report mentions we are: "providing safe, effective and well-led". For the category 'well-led' we even received 'outstanding'. Contents Our story It all began with our first DrEd website in November 2011, which served the UK and Germany by supplying online medication and advice. Shortly afterwards, and following an investment upwards of $1.4 million, we launched in Switzerland and Austria and later in Ireland. In 2016 we established ourselves in France under our new brand name ZAVA. In January 2019, DrEd officially changed its name to ZAVA in Germany and the UK before finally changing its name in Ireland in October 2020. In 2025, ZAVA also launched in Spain.
